annotations.title: Tax disputes: draft the lawsuit or complaint

description: Assembles the Ukrainian text of the lawsuit (or the complaint to the ДПС of Ukraine, or the statement of defence to a ДПС lawsuit for subject P13) deterministically from the service's checked blocks, with the court, fee, deadline and legal basis filled in. The parties stay as placeholders ({{ПОЗИВАЧ}}, {{РНОКПП}}, {{АДРЕСА_ПОЗИВАЧА}} …): never send personal data. Returns the text, the placeholders the user fills in on their own device, the facts still missing (ask the user and call again), checks and sources. The final DOCX/PDF with the stamp is made in the «Податковий спір» wizard on the site or in the app.

appealed.description: A complaint to the ДПС of Ukraine was filed before going to court.

court.description: response only: the court that opened the case (from the ruling).

defendant_region.description: Region of the ГУ ДПС that made the decision.

doc.description: claim = lawsuit (default), complaint = complaint to the ДПС of Ukraine, response = statement of defence (відзив) to a ДПС lawsuit (subject P13 only).

facts.description: Facts of the case by field path from missing_facts (e.g. "act.number", "act.date" YYYY-MM-DD, "act.amount" UAH, "act.delivered.on", "claim.amount"). No personal data.

filed_on.description: Planned filing date. Default: today in Kyiv (YYYY-MM-DD).

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.

plaintiff.description: About the plaintiff — no names or numbers.

e_cabinet.description: Uses the ДПС Electronic Cabinet. Default true.

gender.description: For grammatical forms in the Ukrainian text (подав / подала).

kind.description: individual, or fop (sole proprietor) when the dispute concerns the business.

lives_in_ukraine.description: Has a registered place of residence in Ukraine. Default true.

region.description: Region (oblast) or Kyiv of the plaintiff's registered residence.
